steps.name: Survey CLI path usage
steps.outputJson: {"summary":"Read frozen L3.2.4 and surveyed spec/task/decision/common CLI path usage; all target command groups still used getPaths directly or via default CLI context, so a shared store-aware helper in src/cli/common.ts is the smallest integration point."}

steps.name: Add store-aware write paths helper
steps.outputJson: {"summary":"Added getWritePaths in src/cli/common.ts. It resolves specStore from the execution root, fails fast on error diagnostics with fixes, and returns ProjectPaths for the resolved writeRoot."}

steps.name: Connect spec task decision commands
steps.outputJson: {"summary":"Replaced direct getPaths usage in spec/task/decision CLI files with getWritePaths; handler-backed commands now inherit write paths through createDefaultCliActionContext."}

steps.name: Add external store write tests
steps.outputJson: {"summary":"Added src/cli/__tests__/store-aware-writes.test.ts covering local compatibility, external spec new, external task create/start, external decision create/list, and invalid write root diagnostics."}

steps.outputJson: {"summary":"Ran targeted tests (4 files, 55 tests), npm run lint, and npm run build successfully. Recorded verification evidence V-001 through V-003."}
